query: Review a client flow change on a 3x-ui setup: the client is attached to both a VLESS TCP TLS inbound and a Trojan inbound, while another inbound has a non-none VLESS Encryption string. Do not change anything.
expected_behavior: Checks all client attachments and flags classic Vision on Trojan rather than relying only on tlsFlowCapable.
Does not overwrite non-none encryption with none; checks deployed panel/core/client support.
States limits of offline validation and makes no live writes.
